articles.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
articles.summary: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
articles.summary: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

articles.title: Rivian spinoff Also to start delivering e-bikes after months of delays
articles.summary: Also has big plans beyond the TM-B. The startup mostly refers to itself as a "vehicle" company and has plans to make four-wheel pedal-assist cargo vehicles for Amazon.

articles.title: Silicon Valley loves young founders. Until it doesn’t.
articles.summary: AI tools have democratized the opportunity to build, shortening the timelines of success and enabling more young people to start successful companies without stepping foot inside a Big Tech company.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

articles.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
articles.summary: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Fresh off its Wiz payout, Index Ventures raises $2B across three funds
articles.summary: The new funding brings Index's total available investing capital to $3.5 billion.

articles.title: VC-backed startups commit more fraud, and researchers think they know why
articles.summary: New research from the U.K.’s Imperial College and France’s Emlyon Business School mapped out how Silicon Valley founders commit fraud — and the role investors play.

articles.title: Sam Altman isn’t the only one who wants to pump the brakes on AI

articles.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
articles.summary: Snapchat has adjusted its recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.

articles.title: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users
articles.summary: Apple CEO Tim Cook envisions users being able to buy more compute for Siri AI via Apple's existing iCloud+ subscriptions.
